samples.title: Điện thoại trong lớp
samples.prompt: You let a friend down while preparing for a digital learning workshop. Apologise, explain what happened, and offer a specific way to put things right.
requirementsVi: Xin lỗi trực tiếp về việc đã làm.
Giải thích và nhận trách nhiệm.
Đề xuất cách bù lại và tránh lặp lại.
samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Xin lỗi
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

I am very sorry for missing our planning meeting while we were preparing for a digital learning workshop. I know you were counting on me, and I understand that my mistake made your day more difficult.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu chính xác lỗi, không xin lỗi chung chung.

paragraphs.label: Giải thích
paragraphs.text: The reason was that my train was cancelled. However, I should still have contacted you earlier. I realise that you had to change the arrangements without much notice, and I do not want you to think that I took your help for granted.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích không thay cho nhận trách nhiệm.

paragraphs.label: Khắc phục
paragraphs.text: To make up for this, I can come to the community centre early before the next session and help prepare everything. I will bring a charged phone and check the plan with you in advance. I would also like to help participants try a phone-based research task and discuss classroom rules, so that you do not have to manage the activity alone.
paragraphs.noteVi: Việc sửa sai phù hợp cùng hoạt động.

paragraphs.label: Cam kết và kết
paragraphs.text:
Next time, I will confirm the details in writing and let you know immediately if there is a problem. Please tell me if my suggestion would help. Once again, I am sorry for letting you down.

Best wishes,
Minh
paragraphs.noteVi: Cam kết cụ thể và hỏi cách sửa có phù hợp không.
